title: House Cleaning Checklist Work Order
subtitle: Residential House Cleaning: connects authorized scope to results.
description: House Cleaning Checklist Work Order covers room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item. The home-cleaning service coordinator records Residential House Cleaning authorized tasks, materials, results, and changes. House Cleaning Checklist Work Order keeps Residential House Cleaning exceptions visible until the home-cleaning service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use House Cleaning Checklist Work Order at residence, room sequence, access point, supply area, and excluded space. Document room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item identity before Residential House Cleaning begins. Compare room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item findings with stated Residential House Cleaning criteria; route unresolved Residential House Cleaning issues to cleaning quality reviewer.

sections.title: Work authorization and responsible parties
sections.guidance: For Residential House Cleaning, identify responsible parties, residence, room sequence, access point, supply area, and excluded space, and the linked room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item source.

fields.label: Room list and selected service level
Access, pet, alarm, fragile-item, and product restriction

sections.title: Work-order tasks, resources, and results
sections.guidance: Capture Residential House Cleaning facts for room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential House Cleaning authorized-work checks
items: High-touch, kitchen, bathroom, floor, and fixture condition
Stain, damage, delicate material, and do-not-clean marker
Waste, laundry, dishes, and add-on scope boundary

sections.title: Authorized-work result and open follow-up
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential House Cleaning conditions; have home-cleaning service coordinator assign the next Residential House Cleaning owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Scope changes, holds, and retained evidence
items: Unknown spill, sharp, pest, or hazardous material
Fragile or damaged item without direction
Restricted room, privacy, or security boundary
Requested result requires restoration beyond cleaning
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential House Cleaning when an unknown exposure, damage, access, privacy, security, or scope boundary remains. Retain the available Residential House Cleaning proof and route unresolved room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item scope to home-cleaning service coordinator.
